capabilities.name: Ordered audit log
capabilities.trustStatement: Built into the Yano runtime and covered by packaged-runtime acceptance.
capabilities.description: Append-only ordered application messages.

capabilities.name: Owned key/value registry
capabilities.trustStatement: First-party standard-library state machine bundled in every named distribution.
capabilities.description: First-writer-owned mutable key/value records with committed proofs.

capabilities.name: Authenticated map
capabilities.trustStatement: First-party standard-library state machine with genesis-bound collections, commitment profile, encodings, validators, governed actor registry, policies, and bounded domain API.
capabilities.description: Multi-collection authenticated records with basic, direct-role, and approval authorization plus optional canonical-CBOR and schema validation.

capabilities.name: Threshold approval workflow
capabilities.trustStatement: First-party standard-library state machine bundled in every named distribution.
capabilities.description: Validator-member proposals, votes, and terminal threshold decisions.

capabilities.name: Member balances
capabilities.trustStatement: First-party standard-library state machine bundled in every named distribution.
capabilities.description: Member-authorized mint and transfer accounts for bounded application balances.

capabilities.name: Document trail
capabilities.trustStatement: First-party standard-library state machine bundled in every named distribution.
capabilities.description: Append-only per-entity document and event hash trails.

capabilities.name: Evidence registry
capabilities.trustStatement: First-party preview domain product; it proves recorded evidence claims, not real-world truth.
capabilities.description: Inspection and compliance evidence records with exact committed query proofs.

capabilities.name: Role-gated payload approvals
capabilities.trustStatement: First-party generic role product; applications retain responsibility for interpreting approved payload hashes.
capabilities.description: Governed organizations, actors, policies, and signed approvals for arbitrary payload hashes.

capabilities.name: Role-aware evidence workflow
capabilities.trustStatement: First-party preview evidence profile; external publication requires separately selected ready executors.
capabilities.description: Evidence registration combined with governed domain actors and role-aware release approval.

capabilities.name: Custom JVM plugin state machine
capabilities.trustStatement: Operator-owned advanced path; Yano does not trust or install the plugin automatically.
capabilities.description: Project boundary for a separately reviewed custom state-machine bundle.

capabilities.name: Zero-knowledge proof gate
capabilities.trustStatement: Experimental ZeroJ integration; circuit and verification-key governance remain operator responsibilities.
capabilities.description: Verifies configured Groth16 or Plonk proofs during deterministic state transition.

capabilities.name: Anonymous ZK membership
capabilities.trustStatement: Experimental ZeroJ integration; circuit and verification-key governance remain operator responsibilities.
capabilities.description: Membership authorization using a configured zero-knowledge circuit and nullifier deduplication.

capabilities.name: BBS credential registry
capabilities.trustStatement: Experimental ZeroJ integration; issuer key governance remains an application responsibility.
capabilities.description: Registry for selectively disclosed BBS credential statements from configured issuers.

capabilities.name: Scalus-backed EUTxO ledger engine
capabilities.trustStatement: Experimental reusable EUTxO state-machine engine. A selectable immutable ledger profile defines its admitted transaction behavior; the engine alone is not a Cardano bridge, custody product, or rollup.
capabilities.description: Deterministic Cardano-shaped EUTxO state, root-fixed receipts, address indexes, and MPF-proven outputs under one explicitly selected ledger profile.

capabilities.name: Bounded EUTxO Plutus V3 profile
capabilities.trustStatement: Experimental EUTxO profile v2. It admits key-controlled ADA transfers and bounded witnessed Plutus V3 spending through Scalus 0.18.2; unsupported Cardano fields remain rejected.
capabilities.description: Pins the immutable yano-eutxo-v2-plutus-v3 ledger profile and every consensus-relevant bound.

capabilities.name: Restricted EUTxO key-payment profile
capabilities.trustStatement: Experimental key-controlled, ADA-only, zero-fee EUTxO profile. Scripts and unsupported Cardano transaction purposes are rejected.
capabilities.description: Pins the immutable yano-eutxo-v1 ledger profile used by the current bounded ZeroJ validity circuit.

capabilities.name: Virtual EUTxO genesis allocation
capabilities.trustStatement: Creates virtual test value inside the app-chain only. It represents no Cardano funds and cannot be combined with the federated bridge.
capabilities.description: Bootstraps one explicit ADA-only virtual allocation for no-real-funds testing.

capabilities.name: Federated Cardano EUTxO bridge
capabilities.trustStatement: Experimental federated custody path. Stable deposits and withdrawals depend either on the configured external threshold/HSM signer or on a threshold-accepted MPF root plus reviewed proof/nullifier contracts. The root threshold can fabricate a root. It is not production-funds ready and has no ZeroJ dependency.
capabilities.description: Observes exact accepted vault deposits and settles irrevocable bounded claims through either exact external signing or permissionless current-root MPF proofs with an on-chain replay nullifier.

capabilities.name: ZeroJ EUTxO validity settlement
capabilities.trustStatement: Restricted ZeroJ Groth16 validity profile for development and testnet use only. Its zeroj-jubjub-dev-v1 authorization requires a trusted prover, host-only point validation and disposable test funds. It is not malicious-prover secure or production-funds ready; a hardened circuit requires new ceremony, proving-key, verification-key and validator identities.
capabilities.description: Adds a Yano L2 envelope with a Cardano-compatible body, registered Jubjub session-key authorization, optional Poseidon validity commitment, durable proving interfaces, proof-bound Cardano root advancement, bounded aggregate withdrawal and canonical L1 batch publication.

capabilities.name: ZeroJ Cardano EUTxO rollup label
capabilities.trustStatement: Readiness label only. It remains unavailable until independent reconstruction, operational L1 data retention, external audits, production MPC ceremony and accountable production-funds approval are recorded.
capabilities.description: Graduation label for a separately approved ZeroJ validity product; it does not add runtime behavior.

capabilities.name: EUTxO lifecycle indexer
capabilities.trustStatement: Derived node-local SQLite projection. It is rebuildable and never participates in transaction validation, state roots, finality, bridge authorization, proof verification, or settlement.
capabilities.description: Indexes finalized EUTxO transactions, accounts, bridge lifecycle records, and optional validity batches for bounded APIs and the unified console.

capabilities.name: Fixed sequencer
capabilities.trustStatement: Built into the Yano runtime and covered by multi-node acceptance.
capabilities.description: One declared member proposes application blocks.

capabilities.name: L1-window rotating sequencer
capabilities.trustStatement: Built-in experimental policy whose proposer schedule depends on the local stable L1 slot view.
capabilities.description: Rotates proposership across members using bounded L1 slot windows.

capabilities.name: Static membership
capabilities.trustStatement: Built into the Yano runtime; changing members requires a new reviewed configuration.
capabilities.description: Pins the initial member set as the active set.

capabilities.name: Governed membership
capabilities.trustStatement: Built into the Yano runtime; member changes require threshold-governed activation.
capabilities.description: Allows authenticated member epochs to evolve through replicated governance.

capabilities.name: L1 slot feed
capabilities.trustStatement: Uses the local Yano L1 view; it does not introduce a remote oracle.
capabilities.description: Supplies stable local Cardano slot observations to slot-aware app-chain behavior.

capabilities.name: Cardano metadata anchors
capabilities.trustStatement: Built-in Cardano transaction anchoring; wallet custody and funding remain operator-owned.
capabilities.description: Commits finalized app-chain roots in Cardano transaction metadata.

capabilities.name: Cardano threshold-script anchors
capabilities.trustStatement: Built-in script anchoring; script artifacts, thread policy, wallet custody, and funding remain operator-owned.
capabilities.description: Advances an app-chain anchor thread through a reviewed Cardano script.

capabilities.name: Address deposit observer
capabilities.trustStatement: Built-in deterministic L1 observation; applications must define how deposit claims affect domain state.
capabilities.description: Creates stable observations for lovelace paid to one configured Cardano address.

capabilities.name: Metadata label observer
capabilities.trustStatement: Built-in deterministic L1 observation; observed metadata remains an external claim, not proof of real-world truth.
capabilities.description: Creates stable observations for one configured Cardano transaction metadata label.

capabilities.name: Deterministic effects runtime
capabilities.trustStatement: Effect intents and outcome reports are committed; external mutation remains executor-owned and at-least-once.
capabilities.description: Enables deterministic effect intents, gates, result incorporation, and proofs.

capabilities.name: Generic on-approved effect
capabilities.trustStatement: The approval machine emits the configured typed payload after threshold approval; the external target remains executor-owned.
capabilities.description: Emits one typed chain-result effect when a stock approval reaches its threshold.

capabilities.name: Webhook effect executor
capabilities.trustStatement: Built-in at-least-once HTTP executor; receivers must deduplicate with the supplied idempotency key.
capabilities.description: Executes webhook.post effects against one node-local configured URL.

capabilities.name: Finalized webhook sink
capabilities.trustStatement: Built-in at-least-once finalized-block delivery; receivers own authentication and deduplication.
capabilities.description: Posts finalized application blocks to one configured node-local webhook endpoint.

capabilities.name: Kafka effect executor
capabilities.trustStatement: First-party optional bundle; broker identity, transport security, credentials, topic policy, and delivery operations remain operator-owned.
capabilities.description: Executes kafka.publish intents through allowlisted node-local Kafka targets.

capabilities.name: Kafka finalized sink
capabilities.trustStatement: First-party optional bundle; broker identity, credentials, topic retention, and downstream processing remain operator-owned.
capabilities.description: Publishes finalized application blocks to a configured Kafka topic.

capabilities.name: S3-compatible object executor
capabilities.trustStatement: First-party optional bundle; storage credentials, bucket policy, versioning, encryption, and retention remain operator-owned.
capabilities.description: Executes immutable object.put promotion against allowlisted S3-compatible targets.

capabilities.name: IPFS pin executor
capabilities.trustStatement: First-party optional bundle; Kubo identity, authentication, pin durability, and replication policy remain operator-owned.
capabilities.description: Executes reconciled ipfs.pin intents against allowlisted Kubo targets.

capabilities.name: Cardano payment executor
capabilities.trustStatement: Privileged first-party optional bundle; payer-key custody, funding, transaction caps, backend trust, and reconciliation remain operator-owned.
capabilities.description: Executes bounded cardano.payment intents from an operator-controlled payer wallet.

capabilities.name: Composite state-machine framework
capabilities.trustStatement: Generic framework library bundled for first-party profiles; arbitrary YAML composition is not supported.
capabilities.description: Deterministic component, workflow, profile, query, quota, and profile-governance framework.

capabilities.name: Embedded node console
capabilities.trustStatement: Read-only and privileged runtime-console behavior is governed separately by ADR-028.
capabilities.description: Embedded operational app-chain status console derived from the selected Yano distribution.

capabilities.name: Prometheus observability companion
capabilities.trustStatement: First-party local companion with pinned Prometheus image, bounded retention, loopback query access, and explicit lifecycle; production access control remains operator-owned.
capabilities.description: Optional one-command durable metrics history for the unified console.
